player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in a loop between the Kitchen and the Guest room, repeatedly going east and then west. What is worse, after going back and forth for some time, I decided to continue exploring new rooms instead of checking if I had already visited all the rooms. Next time, I will keep track of the rooms I have visited and check if I have already been to a room before making a move. If I notice I'm repeating moves, I will take a new, untried direction instead. I will also make sure to explore the rooms I have already visited more thoroughly before moving on to new ones.
